questions.def: Simple present tense for habitual actions.
questions.question: I ___ coffee every morning before work.

questions.def: 'Used to' describes past habits or states.
questions.question: She ___ late when she was a student.

questions.def: 'Used to' plus infinitive for past habits.
questions.question: My grandfather ___ a pipe.

questions.def: 'Would' describes past habitual actions.
questions.question: They ___ go to the beach on Sundays.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous for recent habit.
questions.question: I ___ the gym regularly these days.

questions.def: 'Would' to talk about past routines.
questions.question: We ___ our grandparents every summer.

questions.def: 'Is always' + -ing form for annoying habits.
questions.question: He ___ biting his nails when nervous.

questions.def: Simple present for routines: listens
questions.question: She ___ to the radio in the morning.

questions.def: Simple present for regular habits.
questions.question: He ___ tennis every weekend.

questions.def: Describes a regular effort to form a habit.
questions.question: I ___ to the gym three times a week.

questions.def: 'Is always losing' emphasizes the irritating habit.
questions.question: She ___ her keys somewhere.

questions.def: 'Is always forgetting' shows annoyance about the habit.
questions.question: She ___ her umbrella.

questions.def: 'Are apt' shows a tendency to do something.
questions.question: They ___ to complain about the food.

questions.def: 'Makes a point of' shows a determined habit.
questions.question: He ___ jogging in the park every morning.

questions.def: 'Makes a habit of' describes a deliberate routine.
questions.question: She ___ before breakfast.

questions.def: 'Used to' indicates a past habit.
questions.question: He ___ walk to work, but now he drives.

questions.def: 'Don't tend to' = do not usually do it.
questions.question: I ___ go to that cafe anymore.

questions.def: 'Has a habit of' emphasizes a repeated action.
questions.question: He ___ his keys at home.

questions.def: 'Are wont to' = are accustomed to.

questions.def: Makes it a point to do something: makes an effort.
questions.question: She ___ to the gym every day.

questions.def: Has a habit of shows a routine.

questions.def: 'Tends to' shows a common behaviour.

questions.def: Makes a point of doing something: makes an effort.
questions.question: She ___ yoga every morning.

questions.def: 'Used to' is followed by the base form of the verb.

questions.def: Simple present tense describes a regular habit or routine.
questions.question: He ___ his teeth before bed every night.

questions.def: 'Used to' indicates a past habit or state.
questions.question: He ___ heavily, but he quit last year.

questions.def: 'Have' describes a general habit in the simple present.
questions.question: I ___ coffee in the mornings before work.

questions.def: 'Would' indicates a past habit or repeated action.

questions.def: For annoying habits, 'is constantly' implies annoyance.

questions.def: 'Would' describes past habits or repeated actions.
questions.question: As a child, I ___ outside for hours.
